about.label: About the auction
about.title: Things with a story
about.p1: , Rector of the Kyiv School of Economics, is giving his personal belongings to a charity auction. Each one becomes a separate lot, and all proceeds go to a common cause.
about.p2: We want taking part to be simple and the result to be transparent: photos, descriptions and starting prices are published only after the Rector's Office approves them, and a report on the funds will appear here after the final.

01.title: Personal things
01.text: Every lot is something with a story from the KSE Rector's life.

02.title: Online bidding
02.text: Bid from anywhere in the world, with no extra steps.

03.title: Open report
03.text: The total raised and how it is spent, made public.

lots.intro: Each slot will open a separate lot. Photos, names and descriptions will appear once the Rector's Office confirms them.
lots.placeholderTitle: The Rector's Office will add the lot name
lots.placeholderText: No made-up items, specifications or stories.
lots.note: Three demo slots show how the showcase works, not the actual number of lots.

steps.intro: Each step is higher than the last, just like bids. The exact rules will be confirmed before the start.

choose.title: Pick a thing
choose.text: The photo, description and starting price will appear in the confirmed catalogue.

bid.title: Place a bid
bid.text: A bid must beat the current one by at least the lot's step.

result.title: See the result
result.text: After the final, the total and a report on the funds will appear here.

report.label: Transparency
report.title: Fundraising should be
report.text: After the final, the total raised and a report on how the money is used will appear here. No unverified numbers.
report.credit: Details are being gathered by the KSE Rector's Office

final.title: Final
final.text: Bidding closes online; that is the main format. A get-together on campus is still to be confirmed.
final.timeNote: The exact time of the final is to be confirmed.

faq.contact: Didn't find an answer? Write to us

start.a: The public start is planned for early November. The Rector's Office will confirm the exact date.

photos.q: Why are there no photos or prices yet?
photos.a: The Rector's Office has to provide and approve the original photos, names, descriptions and starting prices. We don't put up made-up items.

bidding.a: A bid must beat the current one by at least the lot's step. The secure bidding service will be connected before the start.

who.a: The auction is open to everyone: students, alumni, partners and friends of KSE. Registration terms will be announced before the start.

offline.q: Will there be an offline event?
offline.a: The main format is closing the bidding online. A get-together on the KSE campus is still to be confirmed.

delivery.q: How do I get a lot I won?
delivery.a: The Rector's Office will agree how winners pay and receive their items, and publish it together with the rules.

funds.a: The cause and the account are still being confirmed. They will be published once confirmed, together with the report.

footer.question: Questions about the auction?
footer.note: Materials and results will appear once confirmed by the Rector's Office.

bidModal.title: Bids aren't open yet.
bidModal.text: The site doesn't collect personal data, send bids or take payments yet. Lots and rules will be added once confirmed.

closed.title: The auction is over
closed.text: Bidding closed automatically and the winners are recorded. Thank you to everyone who joined the common cause.
